VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: lustshaper
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: A perverse twist of psychic entropy, shaping desire itself to bend willing or weakened minds toward pleasure.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Lustshapers weave psychic influence into pulses of raw yearning, cloaking allies in lust-shields, conjuring drifting crystals of pheromones, and unleashing storms of desire. Their powers work only on those capable of carnal need.
